identityScopeNotes: ankle-strain carries a FINAL-CLOSE-PROPOSITION-MISMATCH resolution (prior knee/flatfoot claims were withdrawn); the new edge is strictly same-ankle degeneration backed by International Ankle Consortium evidence, and both withdrawn-suggestion notes remain in force.

anosmia was deliberately left unmapped: its FINAL-CLOSE-PROPOSITION-MISMATCH resolution rests on the withdrawal of a depression meta-analysis whose objective-olfactory-impairment finding did not survive publication-bias adjustment.
anhedonia remains deferred as a transdiagnostic symptom rather than a stand-alone condition.
acrocyanosis, ankyloglossia, amputation-of-thumb-fingers-toes, and ankle-disarticulation were deferred: no credible condition-specific target or evidence within scope.

ankle-strain -> osteoarthritis and ankylosis -> osteoarthritis passed the rule-11 check: both are new carriers of a target already carried by distinct primaries, and no narrower identity duplicates these edges.
